text:
Alisha (Marketing): Heads-up: webinar on Wed. Need quick bench runs we can quote in the deck + minimal payloads for demo. Ask to eng/runtime: p50/p95/p99 (ms), tokens/sec, model variant, and a small zip of requests/responses + one-paragraph methodology.
Mike (eng-runtime): Can do. Which configs matter most for you? streaming vs non-streaming, seq length, concurrency, batch?
Alisha (Marketing): Two buckets: 1) Live demo: streaming, ~512 tokens output, 1 concurrent connection, batch size 1. 2) Press stat: non-streaming, 128 tokens, simulate 4 concurrent desktop users, batch sizes 1 and 8. Models: redwood-v2 (float) and redwood-v2-8bit (quant).
Raj (eng-runtime): Good. We'll run each combo x5 and report medians + p95/p99 to avoid single-run noise. Also note instance type (we'll use a100-40g), kernel pack hash, and quant pack version.
Alisha (Marketing): Perfect. Also need tiny curl + node snippets we can paste into slides. Keep them super short.
Mike (eng-runtime): Snippets below. Curl (streaming example):

```
curl -s -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"Summarize product updates","max_tokens":512,"stream":true}'
```

Node (non-stream): `await client.generate({model: 'redwood-v2-8bit', input: 'TL;DR', max_tokens:128})`

Raj (eng-runtime): Run plan: streaming 512 @1c(batch1) and 4c(batch1,8) ; non-stream 128 @1c and 4c(batch1,8) ; both models ; 5 trials each. We'll capture p50/p95/p99 (ms per request), tokens/sec, mean CPU/GPU util during run, and raw logs.
perf-bot: scheduled job perf/smoke/1802239876 started on runtime-staging (a100-40g)
Mike (eng-runtime): We'll also include a quick troubleshooting checklist in the artifact: check pinned CPU governors, GPU MIG off, latest CUDA kernels, and ensure quantized kernel pack v1.2 loaded. If anything flaky we'll note it as "variable".
Sofia (Product): Legal/branding: marketing copy should say "typical p95 under X ms for the tested configuration" and footnote model, instance, and kernel pack. Avoid blanket performance claims.
Alisha (Marketing): Good call. Can you give a 1-line blurb placeholder we can use now so design can layout the slide? We'll replace numbers after runs.
Mike (eng-runtime): Placeholder: "In our tests, redwood-v2 produced 512 tokens with median latency ~XXX ms (streaming) on the tested instance." We'll replace XXX with final medians.
Raj (eng-runtime): ETA: runs complete + artifacts (runs/1802239876/{metadata.txt,requests.log,responses.log,methodology.md,summary.csv}) by 10:00am PT tomorrow. If perf-bot detects >10% variance across trials we'll mark that entry as unstable.
Alisha (Marketing): Thanks — super helpful. If you hit time constraints prioritize the streaming demo numbers. I'll coordinate demo rehearsal with the snippets.
perf-bot: perf/smoke/1802239876 finished: 10 trials queued, 40 jobs completed, 0 failures
Mike (eng-runtime): Uploading artifacts now. I'll DM if we find any regressions.
Alisha (Marketing): Appreciate it — sending a follow-up calendar invite for a quick sync after you upload. :thumbsup:
